cond_0081.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0081.responsibilities:
You will work in an office/lab environment, coordinating with manufacturing engineers, manufacturing leads, quality, safety, and technicians to create manufacturing orders and support hands-on work with physical hardware.

Provide manufacturing engineering support for assembly and integration of space hardware, with a focus on facility 5S and FOD practices in the assembly area, tracking deliverable hardware for discrepancies and NCRs, and helping build and deliver hardware.
Participate in process development alongside the team to improve overall system quality control.
Collaborate on the creation of work instructions and manufacturing orders for production processes and assemblies within the scope of the role.
Provide manufacturing engineering oversight and input during fabrication and assembly, working closely with technicians and other engineers.
Receive feedback from stakeholders and incorporate it into design and manufacturing instructions.
Coordinate with the team on facility layout, evaluating and planning workflow, space needs, and equipment layout.
Support root cause analysis of manufacturing issues in development and production.

Engineering degree in manufacturing engineering, aerospace, or mechanical engineering (or equivalent) with a minimum of 12–15 years of work history in a manufacturing environment.
Work history with composite manufacturing and post layup processing of composite structures.
Familiarity with AS9100 and Quality Assurance and Quality Control industry best practices.
Ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams.
Preferred Requirements
Work history with [Product name masked], [Product name masked], or [Product name masked].
Creative problem-solving approach.
Strong interpersonal, coaching, and influence skills.
